title: TargetDiff
name: TargetDiff
short_description: Generates candidate molecules conditioned on a protein binding-pocket structure.
description: TargetDiff is a 3D equivariant diffusion model for target-aware molecule generation. This service takes a prepared protein pocket PDB and optional JSON sampling settings, then returns generated molecule structures and a machine-readable summary. The summary reports reconstruction and uniqueness metrics only; it does not report binding affinity or biological activity.
dataset_info: The included diffusion checkpoint was trained using the CrossDocked dataset. Inference uses a supplied pocket PDB and does not require the training dataset.
observations: Provide a prepared binding-pocket PDB, typically a 10 angstrom region around the reference ligand as described in the upstream README. Generated structures are candidates and are not experimentally validated.
input_data: One pocket PDB file and optionally one JSON file with sampling settings.
output_data: A ZIP archive containing generated molecules in SDF and SMILES formats and a JSON summary; the summary is also returned separately.
features: Samples candidate ligand structures from a protein pocket using the included TargetDiff checkpoint. Sampling count, diffusion steps, batch size, and random seed can be set in an optional JSON file.
strengths: Generates 3D candidate ligand structures conditioned on a protein binding pocket using a pretrained equivariant diffusion model.
weaknesses: Requires a prepared binding-pocket PDB and GPU resources are recommended. Generated candidates are not affinity predictions or experimentally validated compounds.

assistant.description: This is an LLM based TargetDiff expert.
